posts.subject: About 1 admin
posts.bodyHtml:
So today I was playing on the knife server with @Luckiris and @WHAT and we were speaking on ts3 having fun,


First map 35hp_castle I was on top of the bridge between 2 castle towers and Mason tells me to stop delaying ( I did not realize I was last person alive ) I asked him "How I'm delaying?" He just says "You're delaying" Without giving clear explanation, few minutes later I say "javla hurensohn" when I wanted to say "javla horunge" I accidentally say "huren..." because they both sound similar and I did not mean it.


We move onto a second map and that's what triggers me the most because @wickedy said himself "Don't bring admin stuff to the server" but what Mason does is totally different he says "OxygeN you got kicked out of admin team twice" which already violates what wickedy said so being an normal human being and working with " eye for eye, tooth for tooth" (Shout out to @Helimir for messaging me this) I said to him "Your last application got rejected because you begged for likes".


I'm making this post to show that Mason in fact does not have a perfect behavior himself and I don't have either which my bans show, Mason was brining trouble to other people too not just me or some other people.




Grüße
OxygeN

I realy don't get what your problem is.


You want to "show" that Mason has no perfect behavior with this post?


You must have gotten me wrong, because i didn't said "Don't bring admin stuff to the server" but said "I dont want staff members arguing with each others on the server"... And i didnt said this to you by the way.


So you'd better be glad that Mason didn't banned you for that because both phrases aren't nice eather.
And i've warned you a couple of times now to reconsider your choice of words, because i dont want you to verbal harass all the time - no matter wich language!
Using those cuss words and being rude all the time doesn't make you look better towards anyone.


You could be happy that i wasn't there because i would have banned you for it and mason didn't.


What mason did doesnt violate with what i said and he didnt insult you or anything.


I'll teach you something else - "an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth " is a idiom from the bible and - whether or not taken out of context - under no circumstances a virtue.
Most of the time someone use it he's eather knowing he is doing bad things and need a minor excuse or hes just a bad person in my humble oppinion.


I think you're only posting this because you don't like him and want to position him in a poor light for absolutely no reason.

I actually don't think that that kinda disagreement happened because of some kinda hatred that oxygen cherishes I honestly think that this disagreement is caused by some kinda rather more big privat disagreement as I said as you told me 'bout all that stuff who am I to judge-' but I still think that you guys - Mason and you should have a privat conversation to talk that sorta stuff out but I still do appreciate that you had the courage to post a public grievance about that issue.


Cheers , Zeli

Zitat von burn

so much salt in cs:go

*too much salt in CS:GO

wickedy
